generator_metadata.summary: Color 7 is an irregular target mask; 3-5 other colors are sparse marker sets whose horizontal closures compete by overlap, extra cells, then color.

review_brief:
# ccbf7456811b review

- Repaired the issued base generator: its separated motifs made every target-overlap score zero, so the canonical ranking branch was never exercised.
- The base now constructs target-crossing marker pairs, truthful size/count controls, positive-overlap competition, and an observable extra-cell tie-break through 30×30.
- Built a native `closure_axis` family: canonical `row` bytes are unchanged; `column` applies the same selection rule to vertical closures on matched inputs.
- The family supports independently requested 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries, retaining four distinct private queries for sequential reveal.
- Initial adversarial work found color/frequency shortcuts that fit the minimum column lesson; crossed role-color schedules removed them.
- A second attack found the minimum omitted the final color tie-break; row and column tie cases now appear in the two-demo lesson.
- A third attack exposed an “only full-overlap candidate” reading; each minimum branch now includes a positive-but-partial overlap rival.
- The reusable probe tested 15 relevant shortcuts over 128 seeds and audited 1,024 episodes / 3,328 matched input pairs with no surviving wrong rule or sampler failure.
- Final task tests passed 21/21; the retained probe executed 96 protected-Racket labels, including a skip-step-A counterfactual.
- Authoring preflight replayed 24 parametric labels plus three canonical pairs in protected Racket; the causal witness replay passed.
- Public projection produced 16 one-query views; 24 first-turn invariance checks passed, and deliberate public-file corruption was rejected.
- These are finite reviewer checks only. Exact-source owner qualification/acceptance and training admission remain pending.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 1 color-7 target motif + 2-4 other-color motifs; output is the row-close of the best non-7 color, in color 8.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-dependent table for every candidate containing the closed cell set, its overlap with the color-7 target mask, and its non-target extra-cell count.
sequential_dependency.step_a: For each non-background, non-target candidate color, close its sparse marker cells along the episode-fixed closure_axis: between extrema independently on every occupied row or column.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Rank the intermediate candidates by target overlap descending, extra cells ascending, then color ascending; crop the winning closed cell set and repaint it color 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B reads the closed cells and scores produced by Step A. Sparse raw markers do not carry the same overlap/extra values or crop; the retained protected-Racket skip-A ablation changes the selected final output on the qualified pair.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready native adapter and source inventory for closure_axis=row|column; finite self-review passed, but owner native qualification/acceptance and training admission are still pending.

target_report.summary: Repaired the inert canonical base and built a two-setting row/column closure family with a hardened two-demo lesson, four private queries, protected Racket execution, and a causal skip-A witness.
